load_cfg_config_from_graph: load a CFG config from a JSON graph file using CFG_Config.from_graph
generate_cfg_sequence: generate a valid terminal symbol sequence from the CFG using generate_onedata_pure
compute_next_token_distribution: compute the ground-truth next-token distribution for a valid CFG sequence using solve_dp_prob_highprecision
verify_cfg_sequence_with_fast_dp: verify whether a sequence satisfies the CFG using solve_dp_noneq_fast
find_minimal_cfg_corrections: find the minimum token changes needed to make a sequence satisfy the CFG using solve_dp_noneq
